summary.text: Denise Smith is the Conservative Party candidate for Assembly District 80. She ran for New York City Council District 11 on the Conservative Party line in 2025. Little biographical information about her is publicly documented; she has no campaign website identified and has not completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey.

paragraphs.text: Smith won the Conservative Party primary for New York City Council District 11 in 2025, and in the November 2025 general election received 4.0% of the vote (1,462 votes) on the Conservative Party line, behind incumbent Eric Dinowitz (D) and Stylo A. Sapaskis (R).

She advanced from the June 2026 Conservative Party primary for Assembly District 80 without appearing on the ballot, after the primary was canceled; Ballotpedia lists her as having withdrawn from the Republican primary.
